title: Movement speed
wikitext:
{{redirect|Movement Speed|the small passive skill|Movement Speed (passive skill)}} '''Movement speed''' (often referred to as '''MS''') is a defensive stat that determines how fast an entity can [[Moving|move]] by running. ==Mechanics== Base movement speed is 3.7 meters per second,https://i.imgur.com/7GMSQIS.png and can be modified in various ways, such as [[passives]], [[equipment]], [[flask]]s, or [[buff|(de)buffs]]. It has no minimum or maximum. [[Body armour]]s and [[shield]]s apply an innate movement speed reduction while equipped. The exact penalty differs depending on the base type of the item; this is usually -3% movement speed, except for pure strength or hybrid strength/intelligence body armours which have a -5% movement speed penalty. On enemies, normal rarity enemies can have their movement speed reduced to 0%, rendering them immobile. Magic and higher rarity enemies have a minimum movement speed value.[[Prohibited Library (community)|Prohibited Library]], membership required to view. https://discord.com/channels/991073626721763429/991092346651287623/1469054607375466529 [[Action speed]] affects the speed of all animations, including moving, but does not directly modify the movement speed stat. It instead acts as a separate multiplier. ==Flasks== * {{il|Quicksilver Flask}} * {{il|Silver Flask}} - '''[[Onslaught]]''' grants 20% Movement Speed ==Skill gems that alter movement speed== {{main|List of movement speed related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of movement speed related skill gems|active_skill_gems}} ==Support gems that alter movement speed== {{main|List of movement speed related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of movement speed related skill gems|support_skill_gems}} ==Item Modifiers== ===Prefix=== {{Modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= (mods.domain = 1 OR mods.domain = 2) AND mods.generation_type=1 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%movement%" AND mod_spawn_weights.value >0 |group=1 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 }} ===Suffix=== {{Modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= (mods.domain = 1 OR mods.domain = 2) AND mods.generation_type=2 AND mod_stats.id LIKE "%movement%" AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%movement_skill%" AND mod_spawn_weights.value >0 |group=1 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 }} NOTE: The {{il|Quicksilver Flask}} gained as a quest reward from finishing [[Mercy Mission]] quest in Act 1 cannot roll "of Adrenaline" suffix because its [[item level]] is too low. ===Miscellany=== * Possible [[implicit modifier|implicit]] from [[Corrupt]]ing [[amulet]]s or [[boots]] using a {{il|Vaal Orb}}. (+2%-5%) * Possible implicit from [[Enchantment|Enchanting]] boots. (+6%-10% if you haven't been [[Hit]] Recently) * [[Onslaught]] * [[Rampage]] ==Unique Items== There are several [[unique items]] that affect movement speed. ===Boots=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageID=items._pageID |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%movement_velocity%" AND items.class_id = "Boots" |large=1 |stat=1 |level=1 |stat_column1_header={{abbr|% MS|Movement Speed}} |stat_column1_stat1_id=base_movement_velocity_+% |stat_column2_header={{abbr|%MS

FC|Movement Speed per Frenzy Charge}} |stat_column4_stat1_id=movement_velocity_+%_per_frenzy_charge }} ===Minion movement speed=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageID=items._pageID |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%minion_movement_speed_+\%%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%skeleton_movement_speed_+\%%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%golem_movement_speed_+\%%" |large=1 |stat=1 |level=1 |stat_column1_header={{abbr|% MS|Movement Speed}} |stat_column1_stat1_id=minion_movement_speed_+% }} ==Passive skills== The following [[passive skill|Passives]] grant movement speed bonuses: ===Base passives=== ====Movement speed==== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "base_movement_velocity_+%" }} ====Miscellaneous==== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id like "%movement%" and passive_skill_stats.id not in ( "base_movement_velocity_+%") AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%movement_skill%" }} ===Masteries=== The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to movement speed: {{Query masteries}} ===Ascendancy passives=== ====Movement speed==== {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "base_movement_velocity_+%" }} ====Miscellaneous==== {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id like "%movement%" and passive_skill_stats.id not in ( "base_movement_velocity_+%") AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%movement_skill%" }} ===Tattoos=== {{Drop enabled item table |tables = tattoos |join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID |where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency" AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL AND items.description LIKE "%movement speed%" |large=1 |description=1 }} ==Pantheon== {{Pantheon|q_where=pantheon.id="Lunaris"}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0| * Spells that reduce movement speed now do so with a new debuff called {{stl|Hinder}}. You can only have one Hinder effect on you at once, so multiple movement-slowing spells will not stack. This is currently used on {{il|Abyssal Cry|name=Abyssal Cry}} and the new Wither skill. }} {{Version history table row|1.1.4| *We have reduced the movement penalty that armour types have as follows: :[[Shields#Armour Shields (Strength)|Tower Shields]] now have a 3% movement speed penalty (the same as other shields) instead of 6%. :Body Armour now has a 3% movement penalty, with Strength or Strength/Intelligence armour having a 5% penalty, instead of 4% and 8% respectively. :Plate Vest only has a 3% movement speed penalty, rather than the 5% that other Strength armour has. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Added {{il|Quicksilver Flask|Quicksilver Flasks}}, a type of utility flask that increases movement speed by 40% for five seconds. }} {{Version history table row|?| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==See also== * [[Movement]] * [[Moving]] * [[Stationary]] ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Game mechanics]] {{sister|poe2wiki}}
